page.overview:
What is Galen Erso's field team?

During the waning years of the Galactic Republic, Galen Erso was in charge of a field team of scientists while examining crystals in a cave system on the planet Espinar. Lyra, a human female who would go on to marry Erso and bear his child, served as their guide.
